answer: The 2023 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine recognized Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman for their discoveries concerning nucleoside base modifications that enabled the development of effective mRNA vaccines against COVID-19 [3]. The prize was awarded jointly to the two researchers for their discoveries taking part in the development of effective mRNA vaccines against COVID-19 [2]. Those discoveries were also described as breakthrough uses of modified RNA for therapeutic treatments, which enabled the development of COVID-19 RNA vaccines [1].
